chosenApproach: Preserve every non-scope main blob, overlay exact non-manifest blob SHA identities from green Navigation V2 head 73c473caa4ebc139be4b231d3097760fe5c246e5 (49 paths) and green Wall/Marites stability head dc85ce6ed7bc46a1f314885b6fb1d2739e38dcb2 (4 paths) with no overlaps; add one consolidated V2 scope manifest and cross-feature behavioral integration test. selectionRationale: One independent exact-source candidate establishes compile and regression compatibility without whole-merging source branch history, overwriting signed staging mirror changes, duplicating routes or modifying code already fixed in main. The source is a readiness candidate, not a deployment artifact.

Continue two fully separate PRs without ever testing combined source (rejected: cannot prove a single future RC behaves coherently).
Incorporate unverified SALIKSIK #780 backend migrations in the navigation release (rejected: unrelated RLS/points/feature flags and costly unsafe release dependencies).
